facts.business: Alldigi Tech Limited (formerly Allsec Technologies Limited) provides technology-enabled business process management services including HRO (Human Resource Operations), CLM (Customer Lifecycle Management), and anti-money laundering/KYC compliance solutions.
key_risks: Periodical changes to contracts with customers affecting revenue recognition
Concentration of revenue from top clients
Regulatory and compliance risks in multiple jurisdictions
Talent acquisition and retention in competitive IT/BPM market
facts.related_party_note: Trade payable to related parties of Rs 49 lakhs as at 31 March 2026 (Rs 167 lakhs as at 31 March 2025)
